AutomationWorkflow.title: AutomationWorkflow
AutomationWorkflow.description: User-authored mobile automation workflow with chained UI/device/app steps and scheduling, synced across devices.

title.description: Display title of the automation workflow (1-120 chars).

description.description: Natural language description or summary of the workflow (0-500 chars).

scheduleCron.description: Schedule interval or cron expression (0-100 chars).

isEnabled.description: Whether the workflow schedule or trigger is active.

stepsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of automation steps (TAP, SWIPE, TYPE_TEXT, OPEN_APP, WAIT, SCREENSHOT_OCR, SHELL_CMD, CLICK_TEXT, FILL_FORM).

stepCount.description: Number of steps in the workflow (0-100).

runCount.description: Total number of times this workflow has been executed.

lastStatus.description: Result of the most recent execution.

ExecutionLog.title: ExecutionLog
ExecutionLog.description: Execution history log entry for a mobile automation run or ADB/shell command.

workflowId.description: ID of the workflow or command source.

workflowTitle.description: Title of the workflow or command executed.

commandOutput.description: Detailed step trace or shell output.

SyncedTelemetryLog.title: SyncedTelemetryLog
SyncedTelemetryLog.description: Cross-device synced hardware & network telemetry snapshot recorded from a user device.

deviceModel.description: Manufacturer and model of the reporting Android device (1-120 chars).

batteryTempTenthsC.description: Battery temperature in tenths of degrees Celsius (0-1000).

networkLatencyMs.description: Measured TCP network round-trip latency in milliseconds (0-60000).

/users/{userId}/workflows/{workflowId}.description: Per-user collection of automation workflows and recorded action scripts synced across devices.

/users/{userId}/logs/{logId}.description: Per-user collection of automation execution logs and shell command traces.

/users/{userId}/telemetry_logs/{telemetr.description: Per-user collection of device telemetry logs synced across multiple devices.
